Just wanted to flag that this PR also fixes a related issue with Zellij's auto-select-copy feature (see #14385).

When `copy_on_select` is enabled in Zellij, opencode's OSC52 writes to stdout conflict with Zellij's clipboard handling. Zellij intercepts the sequence but never forwards it to the outer terminal. Writing to `/dev/tty` as proposed here would bypass Zellij entirely and fix both problems at once.
